build.title: Refactor: everything left to build, one build (Oct 28 2026)

said.text: Stop everything from every session right now except the documentation. Put everything left to build into 1 single build in a new session. Send the build to orchestrator and create the matrix then end all other sessions.

steps.text: [windows-terminal s6] Window engine (windows.ts + WindowHost): resize from all 8 edges/corners with touch, maximize/restore, and a frameless option (WindowSpec.frame: the content draws the title bar, e.g. the Terminal's tab strip, with drag + min/max/close hooks) so the Terminal looks like Windows Terminal (Brett Oct 28: no keep-on-screen); fixture
[windows-terminal s7] Window engine: snapping — screen edges, half/quarter snap zones, window-to-window snap, no-overlap option, drop a window on another to split; fixture
[windows-terminal s8] lib-workspace floating panes use the same physics (resize handles, snap, minimize/maximize; no keep-on-screen)

[windows-terminal s9] settings-ui@1 levels → Simple / Basic / Developer / Administrator (Pro→Administrator, Advanced→Developer migration; Administrator shows all) + per-interface visible-set override; fixture + migration (folds apply-all-levels-fable s3)
[windows-terminal s10] Level toolbar on every settings interface (default on, hideable): level picker, Available settings in a collapsible container, the rest in another

[windows-terminal s11] Level editor dialog (switch in settings): left sortable categorized tree coloured available/not, multi-select, toolbar + right-click Add to visible / Remove; right tree of what's on; live updates
[windows-terminal s12] Re-bake apps (skip Patches), before/after shots, differences report; tick apply-all-levels-fable s3

[feature-matrix s1] feature-matrix@1 contract: one dataset (matrix per build ref + profile; items: id, name, why, group, minutes, model, state keep|skip, addedAt, history; never deleted), totals (kept/skipped minutes, Fable/Opus split), version + dirty/applied; fixture + check

[feature-matrix s2] Apply engine: project a matrix onto every list (orchestrator steps skip flags + estimate, pending item, build-queue step, build manager entry, plan) idempotently, never deleting; what changed report; fixture

[enterprise-branding s28] Brand library 2/3: preview pane (light/dark, sizes, animation play), Apply / Set as brand, copy id.

[enterprise-branding s40] CI checks for every new checker, PORTING.md (Android twins deferred), rebuild report, CLAUDE.md status, THREADS.md.

[feature-matrix s3] Console plugin feature-matrix: server API (list dataset, get/add item, keep/skip, edit, apply; no delete), data in its lifecycle dataDir mirrored to the hub; seed a matrix from a build's orchestrator steps
[feature-matrix s4] Matrix view (like the windows-terminal scope list): groups, tick keep / untick skip, add item, totals + Fable/Opus split, Apply lights up when changed
[feature-matrix s5] Matrices grid: one row per build, expandable to its matrix; columns build, profile, date added, time cost (from the matrix), kept/skipped, status, last applied

[feature-matrix s6] Hooks in every builds grid (orchestrator, pending, build queue, build manager, changes grid, plan): row button + right-click "Feature matrix" opening that entry's matrix; through a grid hook registry compatible with share-search grid-attach@1. PLUS (Brett, Oct 29 03:08): the matrix is reachable from the application menu — Build ▸ Feature matrix (the dataset grid) — and from the Builds page toolbar
[feature-matrix s7] Import the windows-terminal scope list (artifact db scope/selection) as the first matrix; seed matrices for every open build
[feature-matrix s8] Lifecycle install/uninstall, tests, before/after shots, report, THREADS, PR + merge approval

[plugin-theme-override s7+s8] Merge PR #161 (built + CI green on c10129f2, branch claude/plugin-theme-override, marked WIP by the STOP ORDER): Plugins ▸ All plugins ▸ <plugin> ▸ Interface · Settings · Documentation · About · Disable (setting plugins-menu.ladder.disableStyle: check mark or plain toggle) + framework MenuSub (submenus flip left only when no room). Merge main in, CI, merge approval

[assistant-approvals s2] framework/libs/approvals: shared library over the approval-badge@1 feed (axHub session, live updates via the hub, approve/decline calls, errors), used by both apps; unit tests

[assistant-approvals s3] Dev Console AI assistant window: badge + popover in its title bar from the shared library; click Approve runs the approval and shows the result; nothing drawn when there are no open approvals; snaps, never overlaps (banner rule)
[assistant-approvals s4] AmberX app assistant: the same badge + popover in its title bar (apps/amberx-droid ai plugin), tap Approve from the phone; an axHub push notification opens the popover
[assistant-approvals s5] Checks (tsc, build, check-theme, lifecycle), before/after shots of both title bars, docs, THREADS, PR + merge approval

[veto-approvals s1] axHub (repo MossesX/axHub, on top of PR #14 hub-runs-approved): tool policy 'veto' = the call is held for a countdown (default 180 s, per tool) and then RUN by the hub itself unless denied; states held → running → ran | denied | expired; Deny API (session, revision-checked, audited; no Approve button for veto calls); vps.run moves to veto. Vinnie = the hub's own agent module that holds, notifies and runs veto calls (packages/server/src/vinnie.ts) and streams the countdown + the command's output as a job stream (SSE) the AmberX terminal can attach to. Approval page/feed: countdown + Deny on the first screen. Tests.

[veto-approvals s2] axHub: Vinnie sends the hold as a push to the AmberX Android app (push channel the app already uses) with a Deny action, a 'time running out' push at 30 s and a 'running' push when it starts; feed fields for the console banner (runsAt, secondsLeft, denyUrl, streamUrl); docs (decision log, context, roadmap), tests, PR

[veto-approvals s3] AmberX app: held-call notification with Deny action; Settings → Plugins → Approvals: notification sound, vibration pattern, 'time running out' sound, 'running' sound (pickers + test buttons, tokens only); the three pushes play the chosen sounds

[veto-approvals s4] AmberX terminal: a Terminal view in the AmberX app (the console-terminal plugin installed in AmberX if it fits, else a tabbed terminal view); when a veto timer starts a tab opens showing the title, the command and the live countdown with a Deny button; at zero it attaches to Vinnie's job stream and shows the command running + its output

[veto-approvals s5] Dev Console approvals banner: held (veto) entries with live countdown + Deny (no Approve), opens the approval page; snaps, never overlaps; AXHub web app approval page: countdown + Deny first screen

[veto-approvals s6] Shared rule + docs: veto calls are sent once and never polled (read the job once at the end); _claude/shared/rules/RULES.md in both repos; tests, before/after shots (banner, AmberX settings, terminal tab), THREADS, PRs (axHub + AXF) + merge approvals

[amberx-voice-wake s1] AmberX (Capacitor shell, apps/amberx-droid/android): silent offline wake listener like ActiveX — Vosk (small en model bundled or downloaded once) running in the hands-free foreground service, matching the trigger phrases (the app's wake phrase + 'always armed' off by default), no system tone; replaces SpeechRecognizer for idle listening

[amberx-voice-wake s2] After a trigger: start Android SpeechRecognizer (Google) for one utterance, feed the result to the existing voice plugin pipeline, then back to the silent Vosk idle; mute the recognizer's start/stop tones (AudioManager on the notification/system streams around the call) with a setting 'play tone on trigger' default off; overlay shows wake vs listening state

[amberx-voice-wake s3] Settings (Voice): trigger phrases list like ActiveX (dense single column, add/remove), sensitivity, tone switch; tests (test.mjs + Java unit where possible), CI compiles the Java, docs (STATUS, _claude/memory/docs/amberx-voice-wake.md), THREADS, PR + merge approval
